findings.description: The first draft named the artifact helper and coalescer changes but did not pin the concrete artifact format or the exact XML wire shape needed for `core/src/tasks/mod.rs` to preserve recovery references after batching.
findings.resolution: Specified a plain UTF-8 `.log` artifact and the exact `<output_artifact_path>` placement for both single-task and coalesced background notifications.
findings.suggestedFix: Name the concrete artifact format and the exact notification/coalescer XML contract so tests can assert the wire format precisely.
